2607.25875.title: A2TTA: Anchored-and-Agile Test-Time Adaptation for Evolving Traffic Sensor Networks
2607.25875.paper_summary: Traffic forecasting is important for efficient traffic management and route planning in smart cities. Existing traffic forecasting studies typically assume fixed sensor graphs, overlooking the continuous evolution of real-world traffic networks, e.g., ongoing road network construction and evolving human mobility patterns. These dynamic changes can substantially degrade conventional forecasting models, motivating test-time adaptation (TTA) to efficiently adapt pretrained models during deployment. However, applying TTA to evolving traffic sensor networks remains challenging in two aspects. First, topology expansion introduces new sensors and connections, continuously reshaping the sensor graph. Second, tem- poral shifts vary in time scale and stability, requiring differentiated adaptation to long-term and short-term shifts. In this study, we address these challenges by proposing A2TTA, an Anchored-and-Agile Test-Time Adaptation framework for evolving traffic sensor networks, which transforms topology-induced forecasting errors into an expandable output calibration problem and separates tem- poral adaptation into persistent global correction and agile context-specific specialization. By jointly addressing topology evolution and multi-scale temporal shifts, A2TTA enables efficient and robust adaptation to continuously evolving traffic environments. Extensive experiments on ten real-world traffic networks demonstrate that A2TTA consistently improves forecasting performance across different backbones, datasets, and prediction horizons. Our code is available in https://github.com/lixus7/A2TTA.
2607.25875.paper_summary_zh: 交通預測對於智慧城市中的高效交通管理和路徑規劃至關重要。現有的交通預測研究通常假設固定的感測器圖，忽略了現實世界交通網絡的持續演變，例如持續的道路網絡建設和不斷變化的人類移動模式。這些動態變化可能會大幅降低傳統預測模型的效能，因此激發了測試時適應（TTA）的需求，以便在部署期間有效地調整預訓練模型。然而，將 TTA 應用於不斷演變的交通感測器網絡在兩個方面仍然具有挑戰性。首先，拓撲擴展引入了新的感測器和連接，持續重塑感測器圖。其次，時間變化在時間尺度和穩定性上有所不同，要求對長期和短期變化進行區別化適應。在本研究中，我們通過提出 A2TTA，一個針對不斷演變的交通感測器網絡的錨定和靈活的測試時適應框架，來解決這些挑戰，該框架將拓撲引起的預測誤差轉化為可擴展的輸出校準問題，並將時間適應分為持久的全局修正和靈活的上下文特定專門化。通過共同解決拓撲演變和多尺度時間變化，A2TTA 能夠有效且穩健地適應不斷演變的交通環境。在十個現實世界交通網絡上的大量實驗表明，A2TTA 在不同的骨幹、數據集和預測範圍內始終提高了預測性能。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/lixus7/A2TTA 獲得。
